title: Rangeley to Flagstaff

waypoints.name: Night 1 Campsite
waypoints.description: Camped next to a big group of french canadiens teenagers, all boys. They had a cool satelite phone setup. We tented next to the lean-to.

waypoints.name: End/Car Parked
waypoints.description: Ended the trip around 8:30. So tired. Exhausting day. Legs in pain. Drove 5:30 hours home to Otis, MA. Got Mcdonalds on the way back. great trip.

waypoints.name: Shuttle Drop Off
waypoints.description: Where Greg Dropped us off. STart of our trip

waypoints.name: Night 6
waypoints.description: Got a torrential downpour at night on my tent with the fly doors open. Got absolutely soaked. Heavy thunder all night long over us and the Bigelows.

waypoints.name: Campsite Night 3
waypoints.description: Hard ass day over Saddleback, the Horn, and Saddleback Junior. Junior kicked my ass. We were both tired. Poplar Ridge site is small and cramped. Lots of folks there already. Met "Little Bear" and "Sans". Cool people. Met a few other passerby thru hikers. Nice tent bed we got. Rained at night and was pouring in the morning. lots of mosquitos. Ate Breakfast under the lean to while it poured outside before heading out.

waypoints.name: Night 4
waypoints.description: Spaulding lean to night. Bunch of old timers were in the lean to. Thru hikers all of them, but strangers. Tented here for the night. It rained a bit in the evening. Clear morning. Ate breakfast and chilled in the leant-to before hitting the road.

waypoints.name: Night 2 Campsite
waypoints.description: Tented here for the night. Huge campsite, lots of empty tent beds. Lean-to was nice, bathroom was super big nice and clean. Met a cool dude called "Vermont", thru hiker, northbound. Loud group of women came in early in the morning at dark and stayed in the lean-to. They were from Boston.

waypoints.name: Sugarloaf Summit
waypoints.description: Cool summit. Tallest peak of the trip I think. Ski lifts and med station were there. and A heli pad. Had a snack here.

waypoints.name: Night 5
waypoints.description: Camped by the river. Great spot.

waypoints.name: Mt. Abraham Summit
waypoints.description: Sick ass summit. Misty and slightly stormy, thunder in the distance. Low visibility, rocky exposed boulder field crest. Sickest summit of the trip in my opinion. WIndy at the top.

notes: A continuous Appalachian Trail route from Rangeley to Flagstaff.

dates.label: July 2021
dates.source: Route description and campsite notes; exact range unknown

waypoints.name: Night 1: Goddard Shelter
waypoints.description: First night, July 3rd, 2021. Goddard shelter, next to the lean to in the tent. Rainy and cold night. SAR helo flew over us at night, searchlights beamed our tent at one point.

waypoints.name: Night 2, Story Spring Shelter
waypoints.description: 2nd night of the trip, July 4th 2021. Cold and rainy again. Camped in our tent next to the shelter. Big family in the shelter.

waypoints.name: Night 3, Stratton  Pond
waypoints.description: 3rd and last night of the trip, July 5 2021. Rain stopped. Camped by the mountain view / NW side of the pond. Great views in the evening and morning. Had some trouble putting my contacts in.
